verdict.rationale: Grok is itself an AI assistant and agent (Grok chat, Grok Bot, Grok Build), so it sits in the MCP client role rather than the server role. The evidence shows Grok connecting to custom MCP servers through connectors and tunneling. That is client-side capability and cannot be credited toward this server story. Nothing shows Grok itself running as an MCP server or offering a first-party hosted MCP endpoint, which is the only thing that would make this axis apply.
